place_fields.summary: The Vijayapura Citadel is the central fortified enclosure within the historic Bijapur/Vijayapura fort complex. The fort and citadel are associated with the Adil Shahi period, with the citadel forming the inner fortified area.

planning_attributes.description: Historic fortified precinct associated with Vijayapura's Adil Shahi heritage.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The citadel is part of the historic Bijapur Fort complex; the fort and citadel are described as Adil Shahi-era structures, with the fort completed under Yusuf Adil Shah in the 16th century.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Vijayapura by road or rail and continue locally to the historic fort precinct.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Expect walking over historic fort surfaces and uneven areas within a large heritage precinct.

place_fields.vibe: historic palace ruin in a landscaped setting
place_fields.summary: Gagan Mahal is a 16th-century Adil Shahi palace and grand hall within Vijayapura's historic fort complex. The surviving roofless structure is known for its large central arch and its setting within a public garden.

planning_attributes.description: Roofless Adil Shahi-era palace and grand hall within the Vijayapura fort complex.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: The central arch has a span of 60 feet 9 inches.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Gagan Mahal was created by Ali Adil Shah I in the 1560s as a royal residence and grand hall. It is associated with the final Adil Shahi period and the Mughal capture of Vijayapura.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The site is in Vijayapura; the nearest railway station listed by Incredible India is Vijayapura Railway Station.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The structure is roofless and is a heritage ruin; stay on accessible paths and avoid unstable masonry.
planning_attributes.notes: Incredible India lists opening hours as 06:00 AM to 06:00 PM. The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly.
